name: Astrid Christensen
bio:
Astrid Christensen's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly after a youthful fascination with engineering led her to an internship with a small Formula Ford team in Denmark. Her meticulous approach and sharp analytical skills quickly set her apart, earning her a reputation for identifying subtle performance gains that others missed. Over the years, she honed her expertise in vehicle dynamics and race strategy, working her way up through various racing series, including stints in touring cars and GT racing. 

At Trackhouse Racing, Astrid is known for her data-driven decision-making and her ability to foster a collaborative environment between the engineers and the drivers. She believes that a successful team is built on open communication and a shared understanding of the car's behavior. Her pragmatic nature ensures that resources are allocated efficiently, and that the team remains focused on achievable goals, even amidst the pressures of a demanding racing season. Her innovative spirit means she is always looking for marginal gains, whether it be through new software or a new interpretation of the rules.

physical.description: A woman of medium build, Astrid has a serious but kind face, often wearing a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized desk, with every item in its designated place.
